archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL SAFETY COMMAND CENTER
theme: Dark Mode Default (Tactical Night Safety & High Contrast UI with Light Mode Toggle Support)
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine high-precision tactical aviation HUD controls with warm human-centric campus wayfinding.
Emotion First: Instill calm, trust, and absolute situational awareness during late-night campus navigation.
Tactical Hierarchy: Information is prioritized by threat urgency and navigation clarity; no cognitive overload in emergency flows.
Negative Space & Optical Density: Dense micro-data panels paired with expansive, high-contrast vector map canvas.
Contrast over Saturation: Pure obsidian dark surfaces tint-blended with slate, accented by vivid signal colors (Beacon Cyan, Safe Emerald, Warning Amber, Alert Crimson).

map_visualization_approach.technique: Interactive Custom Vector Canvas / SVG Campus Map with layer toggles & real-time route path renderers
map_visualization_approach.campus_demographics: Fictional University Campus (e.g., Vanguard State University) featuring 12 key landmarks: Main Library, Science Quad, Student Union, North Dorms, South Athletics, Tech Park, Engineering Hall, Arts Center, Blue Light Stations, Patrol Hubs
layers: Illuminated Safe Corridors (Cyan & Emerald glow paths with lighting score indicators)
Hazard Overlay Pins (Lighting Outages, Temporary Construction, Active Alerts)
Blue Light Emergency Towers (Interactive 1-tap dispatch pin)
Campus Escort Patrol Live Locations (Simulated active security guards)
interactive_features: Click-to-set Start & Destination point with automatic pathfinding calculation
Route comparison mode: 'Max Lighting & Safety' vs 'Fastest Path' vs 'Patrol Monitored Corridor'
Live Hazard Pinning: Click on map during 'Report Hazard' mode to drop incident coordinates
Map View Mode Toggles: Night HUD (Default), Thermal Safety Heatmap, Blue Light Radar

key_features_and_components.name: Navigation & Header Bar
key_features_and_components.description: Sticky HUD topbar with brand logo, quick status indicator ('Campus Threat Level: LOW / ALL CLEAR'), navigation tabs (Map & Planner, Hazard Hub, Emergency SOS, Dashboard Analytics), and Quick SOS Button.

key_features_and_components.name: Safe Route Planner & Mode Switcher
key_features_and_components.description: Origin/Destination selector with quick presets (e.g. 'Library -> West Gate Dorms'), safety factor sliders (Lighting priority, Blue light proximity, Escort preference), and route option cards showing safety rating (e.g. 98% Safe, 450m, 6 mins walk).

key_features_and_components.name: Interactive Campus Safety Map
key_features_and_components.description: Custom SVG/Canvas map render engine with zoom/pan controls, path glow effects, waypoint markers, hazard warnings, blue light towers, and live route step navigation preview.

key_features_and_components.name: Active Escort Walk Mode (Live Companion HUD)
key_features_and_components.description: Turn-by-turn guidance simulator with audio cue simulation, 'I Arrived Safely' check-in button, timed check-in ping, and instant emergency trigger button.

key_features_and_components.name: Hazard Reporting System
key_features_and_components.description: Modal/Drawer form for reporting campus issues: Category (Poor Lighting, Broken Blue Light, Obstacle/Construction, Suspicious Activity), Severity Rating (Low, Medium, High), Map Location selector, Description, and photo preview attachment.

key_features_and_components.name: Emergency SOS Trigger & Blue Light Beacon Dispatch
key_features_and_components.description: High-visibility emergency trigger component with press-and-hold 3-second safety fuse, loud audio siren simulation toggle, direct campus police dispatch hotline simulator, and live broadcast location sender.

key_features_and_components.name: Campus Safety Metrics & Analytics Dashboard
key_features_and_components.description: Real-time command stats: Active Illuminated Path Coverage (89%), Active Campus Patrols (6 Units), 24h Resolved Hazards (14), Average Escort ETA (4 mins), plus recent incident resolution log.

micro_interactions_and_motion.framework: Framer Motion for React transitions & Lucide React for micro-icon animations

animations.path_glow: Pulse glow along SVG path elements for the active route (stroke-dasharray animation)
animations.sos_button_pulse: Continuous subtle amber/red halo pulse around SOS emergency trigger button
animations.hazard_marker_bounce: Micro scale bounce and ping animation when hovering or selecting map hazards
animations.card_hover: Transform lift -translate-y-1 with subtle border highlight transition (transition-all duration-200)
animations.tab_switch: Smooth opacity fade and horizontal slide indicator for mode switches

testing_and_accessibility_guidelines.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements, input fields, modals, map nodes, route cards, emergency buttons, and metric containers MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility_guidelines.contrast_standard: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for standard text and 3:1 for large display titles against obsidian background.
testing_and_accessibility_guidelines.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion transitions with prefers-reduced-motion check to preserve usability for users sensitive to motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the exact layout, colors, typography, and component structure detailed in this document.
Ensure all components use appropriate data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur filters for floating surfaces or sticky headers.
Implement mock data for campus locations, hazards, emergency contacts, and metrics to provide a functional and rich interactive MVP demo.
